name: Proper Stable Sample Compression / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: The stable-compression lower bound applies directly; proper reconstruction is an additional restriction.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Theorem thm:stable-comp-low-NCTD-star.
witness_verification: The singleton family strengthens the former strict full-cube witness: $\mathrm{psUSC}\ge\lceil(n-1)/2\rceil$ with a finite stable upper scheme, whereas $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}=1$ for $n\ge2$. The ratio diverges. See #values/proper_stable_sample_compression_singletons and #values/projected_noclashing_teaching_dimension_singletons.
